versions.changelog:
Initial release of doc-formatter: Automated generation of standardized Chinese official documents with built-in GB/T 9704 formatting and support for 18 document types.

- Supports one-command or interactive creation of notices, reports, requests, and 15 other official templates.
- Automatically applies national-standard layout: font, heading, margins, signature, attachment, and CC styles.
- Offers built-in formal language library and phrase patterns to ensure professional wording.
- Includes one-click export to Markdown, plus easy copy-paste into Word/WPS.
- Flexible: customize sections, styles (formal/concise/detailed), signatures, and paragraph order.
- Guided interface for both step-by-step and direct generation; preview and list all templates.
